payload.question: Is the council collecting the council tax it is owed?
payload.label: Council tax collected against target, Q1 2025/26

target.display: 100% of the amount due by this point

payload.council_caveat: The council's own note: "Collection rate for the first quarter is ahead of target and focus continues to be directed on the recovery of arrears." The figure can go above 100% because it includes arrears chased from earlier years. The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: The council sets itself a council tax collection target of 100% of what is due by each point in the year, and says it will step in below 99%. In the first quarter of 2025/26 it collected 104.05%.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
